product.title: Amsterdam Jordaan Food & Drinks Tour with Eating Europe

description.text: Relish the bites and cultural highlights of Amsterdam's Jordaan district on a food and walking tour. An epicurean guide visits local hotspots for Dutch delicacies such as award-winning Gouda with wine and salami, plus several sit-down tastings off the conventional tourist trail. The calmer sit-down format keeps the outing on neighborhood kitchens rather than grab-and-go snack stops. Stops include The Papeneiland Café, Vishandel Centrum, Café De Poort Amsterdam, Mama's Koelkast, Pat's Poffertjes Oude Leliestraat.

start.description: Stichting Adullam, Noordermarkt 48, 1015 NA Amsterdam, Netherlands

end.description: Return to your Amsterdam meeting point after the final stop on the itinerary.
